# What should you charge for this private dinner or meal-prep visit?

> Free private chef and meal-prep price calculator: enter guests, shopping, prep, cooking, cleanup and travel hours, groceries and overhead, and see a cost-plus price per visit and per guest. Runs in your browser.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.

- [The tool](https://duncan-haywood.github.io/oss-monorepo/private-chef-service-price-calculator/)
